head: Netflix price increase in Japan: plan with ads now 990 yen
dek: Netflix raised all three of its plans in Japan on 14 November, its first increase there since October 2024. Standard with ads goes from 890 to 990 yen a month.
details: Standard without ads rises from 1,590 to 1,790 yen, and Premium with 4K and HDR from 2,290 to 2,590 yen. What each plan includes stays the same: two screens at once in full HD on both Standard plans, and four screens with downloads on six devices on Premium. Existing members move to the new price on a later billing date, and Netflix says it emails them at least a month before.
where: Japan, new members now; existing members from a later billing date
means: If you pay for Netflix in Japan, your bill goes up by 100 to 300 yen a month depending on your plan.
todo: Watch for Netflix's email with your date, and check in your account whether a cheaper plan covers what you watch.
